title: FIPS gate missing: wolfssl/wolfssl_kdf.c/kdf callbacks
description: wolfssl_kdf.c: all six kdf callbacks (hkdf_sha256_kdf at line 90, hkdf_sha384_kdf at line 108, hkdf_sha512_kdf at line 125, pbkdf2_sha256_kdf at line 182, pbkdf2_sha384_kdf at line 199, pbkdf2_sha512_kdf at line 216) contain NO fips_gate() call. The comment at line 56-59 says 'FIPS gating is done by the framework before calling the kdf callback; no gating needed here.' This contradicts the CLAUDE.md design rule which requires the gate to be called in every gated callback. The framework does NOT substitute for per-callback gates per CLAUDE.md section 1c. The kdf callback is listed in crypto2dev_provider.h:110-112 as a gated callback. This is a CMVP compliance failure for all six wolfssl KDF algorithms.
